supplement.scope: Eight supplemental scripted on-foot gameplay captures: Medium Travel and Flight, walk/run, front/back; actual follow rig without override. The separate full-fit report owns actual takeoff, landing, dismount and both mounted sides.
supplement.profile: Fresh nonpersistent Edge context per outfit; no owner profile or existing saves opened.
supplement.staging: Existing terrain standingPoint at spawn +24,+4, normal Player.teleport to onFoot. No world, terrain, companion, camera tuning or runtime asset edits.
supplement.input: Every advance receives explicit scripted input: {} while settling; declared foot controls while moving. Every render receives explicit {} and restores live input afterward.
supplement.cameraContract: Actual on-foot follow rig; yaw/pitch orbit only; collisions enabled; no camera override or custom camera matrix.

visualReview.status: All eight inspected and accepted for bounded visible-fit evidence

independentReview.rootReview: All eight supplemental raw PNGs directly inspected; four Stable build/outfit sheets and mounted full-frame sheet inspected, supplementing direct fresh Stable and mounted image inspections. Independent reviewer inspected all32 accepted raw images.
independentReview.finding: Thin connected Travel cloth covers both shoulders; selected Windkeel main straps rest close to torso across inspected Stable builds and gameplay poses. No gross floating main strap, detached shoulder cap or bulky shoulder shell observed. Flight fit remains close to jacket. Original eight on-foot frames retained/excluded for companion obstruction.
limits: Mounted and follow-camera distance supports broad fit only, not millimetre clearances or hidden contacts
Scripted SwiftShader evidence does not certify physical controller or hardware performance
Final concept likeness and exhaustive cloth/layer collisions remain unverified
